L0203

`use {name}#{selector};` isn't pinned to an exact version.

What

`use {name}#{selector};` isn't pinned to an exact version.

Why

An inline script dependency has no lockfile until `jet fetch --lock` runs; a loose selector (`1.4` rather than `1.4.2`) can resolve to a different version on a fresh clone (D-JPK-SCRIPTDEP1).

Fix

Write the exact version Jet resolved (`use {name}#<major.minor.patch>;`), or run `jet fetch --lock` to pin it in `<script>.lock`.
